title: NEAR Intents loses $3.8 million in smart contract exploit
description: NEAR Intents said on Oct. 1, 2026 that a bug in its Omni deposit and withdrawal system drained about $3.8 million, pledged full reimbursement, and paused deposits and withdrawals on several blockchains.

title: SEC proposes crypto custody rules for advisers and funds
description: The SEC proposed rules on Oct. 1, 2026 that would let investment advisers self-custody client crypto when no qualified custodian is available and allow state trust companies to serve as crypto custodians.

title: Base Activates Cobalt Upgrade With Conditional Transactions
description: Base put its third 2026 upgrade live on mainnet, adding Validity Transactions that wait for preset conditions plus new issuer controls for its B20 token standard.

title: CFTC Wins $31.5M Fundsz Fraud Judgment in Florida Court
description: A federal court in Florida ordered two Fundsz operators to pay more than $31 million in restitution and penalties after finding they sold investors on fictitious crypto and metals trading.

title: US Sanctions Tren de Aragua Network Over ATM Cash Thefts
description: The Treasury sanctioned 10 people and companies tied to Tren de Aragua, saying an ATM jackpotting crew stole millions from US banks and moved proceeds through Tron wallets.
